## Overview

This standalone R program creates physical examination listing from embedded source-logical data. It doubles the original sample or record count, writes the simulated analysis data to Excel, and produces clinical RTF and PDF deliverables.

## Analysis Steps

1. Reconstruct the source-like analysis records and replace subject identifiers with PILOT identifiers.
2. Generate a reproducible simulated dataset with twice the original sample or record count while retaining the relevant treatment and analysis relationships.
3. Apply the population, parameter, visit, and treatment conditions defined in the program.
4. Select analysis records and list physical-examination findings and clinical significance by subject, body system, and visit.
5. Arrange the display data in the required clinical format and generate the Excel, RTF, and PDF outputs.

## ADaM Data and Main Variables

The program uses **ADSL and ADPE** for the analysis.

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `USUBJID` | Unique subject identifier |
| `TRT01AN` | Numeric actual treatment for treatment period 1 |
| `SAFFL` | Safety Analysis Set flag |
| `PARAMCD` | Short code identifying the analysis parameter |
| `PARAM` | Analysis parameter description |
| `PARAMN` | Numeric analysis parameter order |
| `AVISIT` | Analysis visit label |
| `AVISITN` | Numeric analysis visit order |
| `AVALC` | Character analysis value |
| `ABLFL` | Baseline record flag |
| `ANL01FL` | Primary analysis record flag |
| `PEDTC` | Physical-examination date or datetime |
| `PESTAT` | Physical-examination completion status |
| `PEORRES` | Original physical-examination result |
| `PECLSIG` | Clinical significance of the physical-examination finding |

The displayed results use the treatment groups, analysis population, denominators, and category definitions implemented in the accompanying R program.
